description: This file contains the implementation of utility functions for the JSON RPC Server in SuiteCRM, including methods for constructing database query conditions and user authentication logic.

classes.name: JsonRPCServerUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing helper methods for JSON RPC server operations such as constructing query conditions and authenticating users.

methods.name: constructWhere
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause based on provided query conditions, handling special cases for email fields and applying appropriate SQL syntax.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication by verifying session keys and retrieving the current user from the database.
